description: This file defines a class named Repair within the Step\Acceptance namespace. It contains a method to automate the process of clicking through the Quick Repair and Rebuild functionality in a web application via acceptance testing.

classes.name: Repair
classes.description: A class extending Administration, providing a method to automate the 'Quick Repair and Rebuild' process in acceptance tests.

methods.name: clickQuickRepairAndRebuild
methods.description: Automates navigation to the Administration page, clicks the repair option, waits for the repair page to load, initiates the quick repair and rebuild process, and waits for confirmation text.
